notes_for_editor: Only two readable sources. The LIO tower-layer record (name, class, coordinates, location accuracy, verified flag, AFFM note, null height and construction fields) is the sole source about the tower itself; it is cited from the LIO query URL because the GeoHub hub page cached as a shell showing only the word 'Tower'. The forestrangers hobbyist history supplies only general context on Ontario's towers, not this tower. Two web searches and the firelookout.ca detail slug returned nothing on this tower; the cached forestrangers still-standing list names no Township 120 tower. The brief gives no local_unit and the layer has no district field, so the story says Ontario only. The layer's verification date (2010) is not a build date and is not used. Not established: build year, height, staffing, fate, status, access, what remains at the site. Possible leads: Forest History Ontario's Forest Fire Report Files (RG 1-186) and northern Ontario newspaper archives, once a district is known.
